pages.text: Sprinter's Tea will provide you with Speed for 3 minutes after mixing some Ginger Root, Water, and Honey inside of a heated Basin.
Sweet Tea will provide you with Regeneration for 3 minutes after mixing some Sweet Berries and Honey inside of a heated Basin.
Elven Tea will provide you with Speed III and Invisibility for 3 minutes after mixing some Elven Sweet Berries and Sweet Tea inside of a heated Basin.
